free_tier.stated: The tracker lists EUR 3.99 per month for 1 Epyc core, 2 GB RAM, 32 GB NVMe, 3 TB a month on a 10 Gbps port, in Austria and Germany. That plan is the vendor's own Nano VPS on the EPYC page: EUR 3.99 a month, 1 core, 2 GB RAM, 32 GB of NVMe and 3 TB a month on a 40 Gbit uplink, orderable in EU Central Austria and Germany, and the EPYC line runs from that shape to nine plans topping at 32 cores and 96 GB RAM. The Ryzen line on the Linux VPS page is a separate product that also exists: its cheapest tier is Small VPS at EUR 4.99 per month with 1 core, 2 GB RAM and a 10Gbit 5TB/m network line, deployable in Germany, Austria, Netherlands, London, Salt Lake City and New York, with Medium at EUR 15.99 (2 cores, 4 GB, 50 GB, 7 TB/m) and Large at EUR 29.99 (4 cores, 8 GB, 100 GB, 10 TB/m).
